snippet.title: Fish [Epic Games Store]
snippet.description:
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/fish-db1795
version 2.3
3d first person examples: https://youtu.be/5nGQpO2HbbE

3d first person adventure, interactive narrative about Cosmos, history and philosophy, based on Book of world famous Artist, Writer and Philosopher - Nicholas Roerich.

One may drown not only in water. But there's no need to do it anywhere.

What do the worlds live for?
Because this is Beautiful!

FIsh is a game that explores many facets of life, death, Cosmos, planets, phylosophy and everything in between. In the game you follow the story of a man who has won an Award, but to collect it he’ll have to embark on a journey that takes him to secret places.
